description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Dr. Mundo''' throws an infected bonesaw in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] them by 40% for 2 seconds.
description.text: Active: Dr. Mundo throws an infected bonesaw in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and slows them by 40% for 2 seconds.

description2.raw: ''Infected Bonesaw'' has a minimum damage threshold, and is capped against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].
description2.text: Infected Bonesaw has a minimum damage threshold, and is capped against monsters.

description3.raw: If the bonesaw hits an enemy, '''Dr. Mundo''' [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heals]] for 50% of the health cost, increased to 100% against [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] or [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].
description3.text: If the bonesaw hits an enemy, Dr. Mundo heals for 50% of the health cost, increased to 100% against champions or monsters.

leveling.text: Magic Damage:20 / 22.5 / 25 / 27.5 / 30% of target's current health

notes.raw: * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] blocking the ability's effects on the enemy does not prevent '''Dr. Mundo''' from receiving the health cost refund.
